system_prompt_style.note: System prompt construction code not in evidence; skills mounted into agent workspace.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Optimization dispatches can inspect the current skill, read prior decision records and failure summaries, form diagnoses, propose typed revisions

context_compaction.note: executor has context_size 40000 config but mechanism unknown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: SkillHone starts a loopback-only LiteLLM bridge and supplies its Anthropic Messages endpoint to Claude Agent SDK automatically.
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from claude-agent-sdk backend; parser not shown.

edit_primitive.note: Edits via underlying Claude Code tools; not specified.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: SkillHone is just a bundle of skills following the [agentskills.io](https://agentskills.io) standard.
protocol_standardization.note: agentskills.io skill standard; MCP not evidenced.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: land it as a single atomic PR gated by a regression eval.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1: eval, propose, evaluate, accept/reject per iteration.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each diagnosis corresponds to an Issue, each revision to a Pull Request, and each iteration's observations to a Wiki page.
planning_granularity.note: Issues act as stored plan/diagnosis objects; closest fit.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: At each development step, an agent runtime dynamically dispatches fresh, role-bounded optimization and evaluation subagents on demand.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: SkillHone therefore uses role-bounded sub-agent dispatches, rather than a fixed multi-agent system
delegation_mechanism.note: Quote spans PDF hyphenation; see agents/*.md subagent definitions.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: SkillHone represents each development step as a decision record

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Wiki — per-iteration observations that later runs read.
long_term_memory.note: Persistent decision history in Git issues/PRs/wiki; skills evolved as library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: SkillHone lets later agents continue from where prior runs left off, audit what has been tried, and avoid redundant edits.
state_persistence.note: Cross-session continuation via decision history, not in-run state reload.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Eval dispatches return redacted evidencee t forr t
self_verification.note: Regression eval on probes; separate evaluation subagents and reviewer agents.

retry_policy.note: Iteration count user-specified; revisions accepted/rejected per iteration.

termination_condition.note: Also executor max_iterations 150; iteration count T.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Improver, executor, and synthesis can each use independent credentials and endpoints.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Some SkillHone-Skills workflows may use Claude Code bypass mode and local command execution, such as `exec` / subprocess calls
execution_isolation.note: User advised to run in container/VM; Forgejo in docker.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The public skill repo and the private eval repo are isolated by code and filesystem permissions, not by prompts.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Some SkillHone-Skills workflows may use Claude Code bypass mode

tracing.evidence_quote: Every step lands as a real issue, branch, commit, PR, or wiki entry

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Runs and interprets evaluations — eval / probe / PR-validation, regression checks, trajectory diagnosis.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Evaluation subagents can inspect probes and traces and run candidate skills, but re-turn only redacted evidence to the optimization side.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a harness for contin-ual agent skill evolution grounded in persis-tent decision history.

open_source.evidence_quote: SkillHone is released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
open_source.note: Paper's internal harness is closed; repo is a reimplementation.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The same configuration covers DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and other LiteLLM providers

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The SkillHone harness in the paper is built on an enterprise-internal agent framework with no current plans for open-source release.

pinned_version.note: No tagged release is shown; the pin is a main-branch commit with a short hash only. This is the SkillHone-Skills bundle, not the paper's internal harness.

stars.note: Star count comes from the evidence header, not from a dated gh api call; the date of the count is not stated.
